description: This file defines an abstract class 'TemporalExpression' used for representing and evaluating temporal expressions within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for obtaining the first occurrence date, checking if a date is included, and generating a range of dates matching the expression. The class utilizes the ICU Calendar library and is designed to be extended by specific temporal expression implementations.

classes.name: TemporalExpression
classes.description: An abstract class for representing temporal expressions, providing common functionality and interfaces for subclasses to define specific behaviors.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles a visit by a TemporalExpressionVisitor.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this expression with another based on their sequence value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on id and sequence.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on id and sequence.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence used for sorting expressions.

methods.name: setSequence
methods.description: Sets the sequence used for sorting expressions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the expression.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the expression.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first occurrence of the expression on or after the given date.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if the expression includes the specified date.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns a set of dates within a specified range that match the expression.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Determines if the expression is a candidate for substitution given a date.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next occurrence of the expression after a given date.
